anegy.title: Anegy
anegy.description: A movie and series platform featuring favorites, watched lists, a generator, and advanced search and filtering options.
anegy.about: Anegy is a personal project that allows visitors to discover, save, and keep track of movies and series. The website uses the TMDB API and includes features such as favorites, watched lists, and a movie and series generator. Users can also search and filter by movies, series, and people. The application supports both Dutch and English and offers both light and dark mode support.

montiraMassage.about: Montira Massage is a website developed for a massage salon with a focus on calmness, appearance, and usability. The website was built using WordPress and Elementor and includes an online booking system powered by Bookly, allowing visitors to easily schedule appointments.

thaiWokToGo.title: Thai Wok To Go
thaiWokToGo.description: A WordPress website for a Thai restaurant with a clear HTML menu and route integration.
thaiWokToGo.about: Thai Wok To Go is a website for a Thai restaurant, built with WordPress. The website includes a clear menu built with HTML, allowing visitors to quickly browse the available dishes. A Maps integration was also added, making it easy for visitors to find the route to the restaurant.

sonsOfTheSeaCustoms.title: Sons of the Sea Customs
sonsOfTheSeaCustoms.description: A WooCommerce webshop for MCC Sons of the Sea merchandise with animations, multiple languages, and Instagram integration.
sonsOfTheSeaCustoms.about: Sons of the Sea Customs is a webshop developed for MCC Sons of the Sea to sell merchandise. The webshop was built with WordPress and WooCommerce and includes various animations to give the website a lively appearance. The website also supports multiple languages, including Dutch, English, and German. In addition, Instagram posts from MCC Sons of the Sea are displayed on the website.
